leftEvidence.title: Moses descends with a shining face

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Moses comes down Sinai carrying the tablets without knowing that his face shines because the LORD spoke with him.
points.right: After six days Jesus takes three disciples up a high mountain; his face shines, his clothes become white, and Moses and Elijah appear speaking with him.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Aaron and Israel fear approaching; Moses speaks, then uses a veil between encounters.
points.right: Peter proposes three tents; a bright cloud overshadows them, the voice names the beloved Son and commands listening, and the frightened disciples finally see Jesus alone.

payload.posture: Exodus and Matthew make a face visibly radiant around mountain revelation.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John

payload.tension: Exodus explains Moses’ radiance through speaking with the LORD; Matthew describes Jesus being transfigured.
payload.title: Moses’ shining face and Jesus’ shining face
